title: Decision record
description: Capture a decision with context and reviewable consequences.

decision.title: Pin exact schema versions in Studio
decision.context: Catalog browsing can suggest a family, but apply must stay exact.
decision.choice: Add a candidate at a named version and hash before Workspace apply.

replay.title: Replay stays deterministic
replay.effect: Studio apply uses the reviewed hash, not the latest catalog name.
